idea-plugin.name: TruthSpine
idea-plugin.description:
TruthSpine Knows Your Project Truth and Automatically Keeps Your Agents Current, Start to Finish.

Persistent agent memory and project context for AI coding agents, delivered over MCP — local-first.

Project truth is your project's living record: the latest decisions, completed work, supporting evidence, open uncertainty, and next steps — kept current, stored locally on your machine, and traceable through SHA-256 parent-child lineage.

TruthSpine knows your project truth from the sources you connect, keeps it current as your project changes, and automatically gives your connected agents the project knowledge and next work they need — delivered over MCP.

  • Connect the exact project open in your JetBrains IDE.
  • Open the local TruthSpine app from the Tools menu.
  • Copy the MCP configuration or the short chat attach phrase when your workspace needs it.

Watch TruthSpine brief a brand-new agent chat (60 seconds) — zero re-explaining, straight to the next work.

TruthSpine is local-first. This plugin does not collect telemetry or upload project content.

This connector is free and licensed under Apache License 2.0. The TruthSpine desktop app is installed and licensed separately. All licensing is handled by the app stores — the Microsoft Store on Windows and the App Store on macOS — and the app runs only while the store reports valid usage permission. Both stores offer a free 14-day trial license. If a trial expires without purchase, the protected app features pause until a valid purchase entitlement exists — your project files are never deleted, and the free connectors keep working. Installing the plugin does not start a TruthSpine trial or create a separate connector license.

On Windows, you acquire the one-time free Microsoft Store trial add-on to start the 14-day trial. A one-time USD 95 purchase through the Microsoft Store unlocks TruthSpine V1 and all 1.x updates. Ownership follows your Microsoft account and Microsoft's eligible-device and restoration rules; reinstalling does not restart the trial.

On Mac, the 14-day trial starts only after you choose it and Apple completes the StoreKit transaction. A one-time USD 95 non-consumable purchase through the App Store unlocks TruthSpine V1 and all 1.x updates, and Restore Purchases restores access on eligible Macs.

Future major versions are separate purchases.
